title: DocuTrack AI
tagline: RAG assistant for shipping & customs documents
highlights: Retrieval-augmented Q&A service (FastAPI, FAISS, sentence-transformers) over 10 real public-domain U.S. government shipping & customs documents.
LLM invoice-extraction endpoint parsing commercial-invoice PDFs into structured fields.
Anti-hallucination confidence guard with a switchable LLM backend (Gemini/Ollama/mock).
